text:
Emily M: Hey folks 3 dropped the latest full draft of the Redwood Dedicated launch post into Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDEF. Main asks: tone pass, benchmark callouts, hero image crop, and legal quick-pass on claims.
Raj P: on it. will tidy the benchmark blurb so it's compact. aim to include p50/p95 + cost/1k tokens.
Sarah D: can we use the wide hero I uploaded earlier? fits header constraints. also need the CTA button spec (primary/secondary).
Tim E: sharing the perf test summary from dedicated pool: p50=85ms, p95=220ms, throughput=4.5k tokens/s on an 8xA100 pool. pasted snippet into the doc.
Tim E: ```
Perf run: run-2026-03-15
p50: 85ms
p95: 220ms
throughput: 4500 tokens/s
cost est: $0.006/token (quantized)
Baseline run id: baseline-2026-03-10
```
Raj P: suggested one-liner for hero: "Up to 3x lower p95 latency and 40% lower per-token cost in our tests vs. the baseline serving stack." will add a parenthetical link to methodology.
Olivia L: legal prefers hedged language: use "in our tests" and include methodology details + run IDs. avoid absolute superlatives like "fastest". add "results may vary" note in appendix.
Emily M: Tim, can you paste the baseline config + run IDs into the appendix? we'll reference it from the hero blurb.
Tim E: done. appended env specs and commands used to reproduce.
Sarah D: CTA design rec: Primary button text: "Try Dedicated 3 14-day credits". secondary link: "See benchmark appendix". microcopy under primary: "No infra changes, same API." Also need hubspot link + UTM.
Raj P: proposed UTMs: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=dedicated_launch_q1, utm_content=primary_cta. I'll generate final UTM URLs for the sales team.
Lana S: SEO check: headline looks good but can we test two variants? 1) "Redwood Dedicated: Predictable inference at scale" 2) "Reduce inference latency and cost with Redwood Dedicated". I'll run both in the headline tester and report back. Meta description needs <160 chars.
Emily M: perfect. approvals needed: product (Raj), design (Sarah), legal (Olivia), SEO (Lana). reply with :thumbsup: when done. Target publish: next Wednesday EOD.
Raj P: minor copy tweak in demo flow; swapped two paragraphs in the Google doc. :thumbsup: on content once hero blurb links are in.
Sarah D: :thumbsup: design good, hero crop uploaded as hero-wide-final.png. confirm margins before publish.
Olivia L: :thumbsup: legal approved hedged benchmark phrasing and methodology link present.
Lana S: :thumbsup: SEO thumbs up after headline test. favor variant 2 for CTR.
Emily M: Tim, can you schedule the CMS draft and make sure preview link posts to #all-hands via publish-bot? Also confirm redirects are in place for the old blog path.
Tim E: scheduled draft for 2026-03-24 16:00 PT. set preview URL and added redirect ticket to infra: #1234. publish-bot will post preview when live.
Maya (publish-bot): Scheduled post "Redwood Dedicated: predictable inference at scale" for 2026-03-24 16:00 PT. Preview: https://cms.redwood.ai/preview/dedicated-launch
Emily M: final checklist: hero crop (Sarah), UTMs and shortlink (Raj), legal blurb in appendix (Olivia), methodology + run IDs linked (Tim), headline variant chosen (Lana). I'll send a Monday morning reminder.
Raj P: I'll produce the UTM'ed hubspot links and provide a short link for SDRs.
Emily M: great work everyone. closing thread unless blockers pop up. :rocket:
